You will help build the ground-control, mission-planning, command-and-control, and debrief tools through which operators understand, supervise, and control complex autonomous systems. You will bring strong frontend engineering experience across modern web and/or desktop technologies, supported by practical C++ and backend or distributed-systems foundations. You will work closely with autonomy, systems, flight-test, product, and operational teams to turn sophisticated platform capabilities into clear, responsive, and mission-effective operator experiences.

You will define and evolve test architecture, validation infrastructure, MLOps quality systems, and CI/CD pipelines that enable the Hivemind software ecosystem to create, test, and deploy resilient autonomy capabilities for unmanned aircraft and robotic platforms operating in complex, contested, and GPS-denied environments. You will work across production flight code, machine learning models, simulation and synthetic environments, mission planning and orchestration systems, operator-facing Ground Control Station applications, telemetry and data pipelines, cloud-native developer infrastructure, and hardware-in-the-loop systems. In this hands-on Staff role, you will lead complex, cross-functional initiatives, establish automation and verification standards, identify systemic quality risks, and develop scalable test infrastructure. This role will support international defense simulation, training, test, and evaluation customers, with a focus on Australia, the Indo-Pacific, AUKUS, and allied defense partners. This is a highly cross-functional role requiring deep technical knowledge of aeroelastic theory, loads derivation, and flight vehicle behavior. You’ll collaborate closely with structural design, aero, GNC, and test engineering teams to ensure load paths are accurate, traceable, and validated through test or simulation.

jobs.description_text: Woven by Toyota is enabling Toyota’s once-in-a-century transformation into a mobility company. Team Our data platform team is working on accelerating autonomous driving by providing access to petabytes of data collected by our fleet of autonomous and non-autonomous vehicles. Efficient, fast and cost-effective access to data at large scale is key to tackle the hardest problems in AD/ADAS, from developing the Machine Learning (ML) models for perception and prediction of human driving patterns, to increasing the sophistication of our validation and simulation by identifying rare and interesting real-world driving situations. The data ecosystem developed by the London team is a key building block for developing and testing modern AD/ADAS products that will impact millions of customers. Our ML and Data pipelines are built on-top of the open-source Flyte orchestration framework and are deployed to AWS. Pipeline code is written in Python. We use SQS and Kafka to automate data connections and leverage BigQuery and ElasticSearch for data storage. jobs.title: Analyste en Planification des Actifs
jobs.description_text: Chez Lyft, notre mission est de servir et de connecter. Nous y parvenons en favorisant un environnement de travail où chacun trouve sa place et a la possibilité de s'épanouir. Lyft Urban Solutions fournit les systèmes de vélos et de trottinettes en libre-service qui permettent à des millions de personnes de se déplacer dans plus de 60 villes à travers le monde. Nous avons créé le premier système de vélos en libre-service automatisé d'Amérique du Nord et restons à la pointe de la révolution de la micromobilité. Nos systèmes sont présents partout dans le monde : de Citi Bike à New York à BIXI à Montréal, en passant par Divvy à Chicago, Capital Bikeshare à Washington D.C., et des systèmes emblématiques à Austin, Barcelone, Bogota, Boston, Buenos Aires, Columbus, Détroit, Dubaï, Londres, Madrid, Mexico, Monaco, Pittsburgh, Portland, Rio de Janeiro, San Francisco, Toronto et bien d'autres villes. Nous ne sommes pas de simples fournisseurs de technologies : nous exploitons ces systèmes, en développant les logiciels, le matériel et les opérations qui permettent à la micromobilité urbaine de fonctionner à grande échelle. L'équipe de Lyft Urban Solutions à Montréal est en pleine croissance, et nous recherchons un(e) Analyste en planification des actifs. Ce rôle soutiendra la planification et l'allocation des pièces de rechange dans tous les marchés de micromobilité où Lyft est présente. This role requires full-time, on-site presence at our Nyon, Switzerland office. We're not able to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be prepared to relocate. Key Responsibilities: Own the functional safety lifecycle for fuel cell systems from concept to release Lead hazard and risk analyses (HARA, HAZOP, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA) and define safety goals Derive safety requirements and concepts and allocate them across hardware, software and controls Define/verify safety mechanisms, diagnostics and safe states with the controls and embedded teams Perform safety analyses and calculations (SIL/PL/ASIL determination, metrics, PFH/PFD) Compile safety cases, safety plans and supporting documentation for certification Interface with notified bodies, certification authorities and customers on safety topics Promote a strong safety culture and coach teams on functional safety practices Skills and Experience Required: BSc/MSc in electrical, electronic, mechatronic, control or safety engineering is mandatory Minimum 3-5 years of functional safety experience in industrial, energy or hydrogen systems Working knowledge of safety standards (ex. IEC 61508, ISO 13849, ISO 26262 and/or IEC 62061) Hand

In Zoetermeer werkt ons grafeenteam aan de toekomst van de halfgeleiderindustrie, van onderzoek en ontwikkeling tot industrialisatie. Die processen vormen de basis van onze geïntegreerde grafeenfotonica. Het team pioniert met nieuwe procestechnologie en schaalt die op tot productierijpe oplossingen. Zo wordt baanbrekend onderzoek omgezet in de bouwstenen van de chips van morgen. De functie Black Semiconductor is op zoek naar een gemotiveerde Technicus (m/v/x) om ons team op locatie in Zoetermeer, Nederland, te versterken. Je speelt een cruciale rol bij het waarborgen van de betrouwbare werking van alle technische systemen die onze cleanroomomgeving ondersteunen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onderhouds-, storingsanalyse- en reparatiewerkzaamheden aan voorzieningen zoals luchtbehandeling, gas-, water- en elektrische systemen.
